in_hindi.name: भवती
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह व्यक्ति जीवन में बनती है (Bhavati hai, she becomes/evolves in life)

in_tamil.name: பவேதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவ்வளவு இருவர் ஜிவன் மேல் ஏவம் போவாது (Bhaveta ippadai iruvar jivan meyl evam poyathu, she becomes/evolves into something for another being in life)

in_telugu.name: భవేత
in_telugu.long_meaning: అదేశమే జివేశ్చరిత్యేయోయిన ఎప్పటిగా బహోదేశయేదే (Bhaveta adesam jiveshcharitheyo yinu, she becomes/evolves into something desirable for another being)

in_marathi.name: Bhaveta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of emotions
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaveta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavetas are named after Bhava, the Sanskrit word for emotion. In Hindu mythology, Bhava is a manifestation of Lord Shiva, representing passion and love. Bhavetas are believed to embody these powerful emotions.

in_bengali.name: Bhaveta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of emotions
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhaveta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhavetas are named after Bhava, the Sanskrit word for emotion. In Hindu mythology, Bhava is a manifestation of Lord Shiva, representing passion and love. Bhavetas are believed to embody these powerful emotions.
